title: GST 111 (COOU) | Chapter Four: Improving Your Study Skills Through the Use of Library
subject: GST 111

questions.question: The word library is of Latin origin Liber meaning?
questions.explanation: The word library is of Latin origin Liber meaning book.

questions.question: In Greek and Romance languages, the corresponding term for library is?
questions.explanation: In Greek and Romance languages the corresponding term is bibliotheca.

questions.question: According to Fayose (2001), the library is essential to any?
questions.explanation: Fayose (2001) noted that the library is essential to any educational development.

questions.question: Encyclopaedia Americana defined a library as a place where books and non-book materials are kept for the purpose of?
questions.explanation: Encyclopaedia Americana defined a library as a place where books and non-book materials are kept for reading and research.

questions.question: According to Ode and Omokaro (2010), library is a designated building where information in prints and other formats are?
options: Collected, organized, carefully prepared and made accessible
Printed and bound for commercial distribution
Stored and hidden from public view
questions.explanation: Ode and Omokaro (2010) state that library is a designated building where information in prints and other formats are collected and organized.

questions.question: Library materials can be print or?
questions.explanation: Library materials can be print or non-print.

questions.question: A library can be described as a systematic?
options: Binding and repair of damaged books
questions.explanation: A library can be described as a systematic acquisition of information materials in different forms.

questions.question: Information materials in the library are meant to be used for personal development, career development, awareness, research and?
questions.explanation: Information materials in the library are meant to be used for personal development, career development, awareness, research, studying and for fulfilling one goal or the other.

questions.question: Libraries are maintained by private individuals, institutions, corporate organizations and?
questions.explanation: Libraries are maintained by private individuals, institutions, corporate organizations, government bodies etc.

questions.question: Academic libraries are libraries established in the institutions of?
questions.explanation: Academic libraries are established in the institutions of higher learning such as Universities, Polytechnics and Colleges of education.

questions.question: The main objective of an academic library is to provide maximum learning materials to its?
questions.explanation: The main objective of an academic library is to provide maximum learning materials to its users.

questions.question: A university library is regarded as the ______ of the intellectual activities of the university.
questions.explanation: A university library is regarded as the brain box of the intellectual activities of the university.

questions.question: The quality of a university is measured by the services provided by the?
questions.explanation: The quality of a university is measured by the services provided by the library.

questions.question: The users of the university library include students, researchers, teaching and non-teaching staff and the?
questions.explanation: The users of the university library include students, researchers, teaching and non-teaching staff and the host community.

questions.question: The university libraries have a?
questions.explanation: The university libraries have a hierarchical structure where the university librarian manages the administration of the library.

questions.question: Modern university libraries are usually divided into?
questions.explanation: Modern university libraries are usually divided into five major departments.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a department of a modern university library?
questions.explanation: The departments are Administrative, Technical, Readers services, ICT and Serial departments; Sales department is not one of them.

questions.question: Most university libraries in Nigeria use which classification scheme?
questions.explanation: Most university libraries in Nigeria use Library of Congress classification scheme.

questions.question: Law materials in Nigerian university libraries are classified with?
questions.explanation: Law materials are classified with the use of Moy's classification scheme.

questions.question: A national library is a library specifically established by the?
questions.explanation: A national library is a library specifically established by the Federal government of a country.

questions.question: The National Library of Nigeria was established by the National Library Act of?
questions.explanation: The National Library of Nigeria was established by the National Library Act 1964.

questions.question: The National Library of Nigeria is centrally located in?
questions.explanation: The National Library of Nigeria is centrally located in Abuja, its headquarters.

questions.question: The National Library of Nigeria is responsible for the issuance of?
questions.explanation: It is responsible for issuance of the International Standard Book Number (ISBN) and the International Standard Serial Number (ISSN).

questions.question: The National Library of Nigeria compiles and publishes the?
questions.explanation: It compiles and publishes the National Bibliography of Nigeria.

questions.question: Public library is also called ______ library.
questions.explanation: Public library is also called circulatory library.

questions.question: Public library is generally funded from?
questions.explanation: Public library is generally funded from public source such as tax money.

questions.question: Public libraries reach users who are unable to reach the library through?
questions.explanation: Public libraries perform this function through the help of mobile library vans.

questions.question: Private libraries are libraries owned, guided and established by?
questions.explanation: Private libraries are libraries owned, guided and established by individuals or families.

questions.question: Prof. Kenneth Dike Memorial Library Awka is an example of a?
questions.explanation: Prof. Kenneth Dike Memorial Library Awka is an example of a private library.

questions.question: Special libraries are usually established by research institutes, professional bodies, government agencies and?
questions.explanation: Special libraries are usually established by research institutes, professional bodies, government agencies, industries, financial institutions etc.

questions.question: Central Bank of Nigeria Library is an example of a?
questions.explanation: Central Bank of Nigeria Library is an example of a special library.

questions.question: In university libraries, the administrative section is headed by the?
questions.explanation: In university libraries, the administrative section is headed by the University Librarian.

questions.question: The circulation section is also known as?
questions.explanation: The circulation section is also known as reader's services section.

questions.question: Members are advised to keep their personal belongings in the?
questions.explanation: Members are advised to keep their personal belongings including hand bags and umbrellas in the property counter.

questions.question: Members have to show their membership identity card at the?
questions.explanation: Members have to show their membership identity card at the security desk.

questions.question: The section that manages the flow of library materials in and out of the library is?
questions.explanation: The circulation counter manages the flow of library materials in and out of the library.

questions.question: Receiving requests from Heads of Departments for new books is a function of the?
questions.explanation: Receiving requests from Heads of Departments for new books is a function of the acquisition section.

questions.question: The Dewey Decimal Classification Scheme is used in the?
questions.explanation: Dewey Decimal Classification Scheme is used in the classification section.

questions.question: A call number consists of a class number and a?
questions.explanation: A call number consists of a class number and book number.

questions.question: The call number is written on the?
questions.explanation: The call number is written on the spine label of the book.

questions.question: The bibliographic details like edition, year of publication and subject are prepared in the?
questions.explanation: The bibliographic details like edition, year of publication and subject are prepared in the catalogue section.

questions.question: The section responsible for the management of journals, magazines and newspapers is?
questions.explanation: The periodical/serials section is responsible for the management of journals, magazines and newspapers.

questions.question: Reference materials in the library are usually marked with the letter?
questions.explanation: The materials in the reference section are usually marked R or Ref.

questions.question: Microforms include the red microform, microfiche, micro-card and?
questions.explanation: There are four types of microforms: the red microform, microfiche, micro-card and microprint.

questions.question: The reprographic section reproduces materials through photocopying, microfilming and?
questions.explanation: The reprographic section reproduces materials through photocopying, microfilming, duplicating etc.

questions.question: Library catalogue is described as an index for the system because it is a record of what the library?
questions.explanation: Library catalogue is an index for the system because it is a record of what the library stocks.

questions.question: Which of these is a form of library catalogue?
questions.explanation: Card catalogue is one of the forms of library catalogue listed.

questions.question: The author entry is usually called the?
questions.explanation: The author entry is usually called the main entry because it is fuller than the other entries.

questions.question: The Dewey Decimal Classification was propounded by Melvil Dewey in?
questions.explanation: The DDC was propounded by Melvil Dewey in 1873 and first published in 1876.

questions.question: The Library of Congress Classification was developed by Herbert Putnam in?
questions.explanation: The Library of Congress Classification was developed by Herbert Putnam in 1897.
